title: OpenTelemetry against Azure Monitor, and portability of instrumentation

videos.script: Lesson 11 read the tables Application Insights fills. Something in the application has to fill them. {{fill}} That something used to be a vendor's SDK, and changing vendors meant rewriting it. {{sdk}} OpenTelemetry is the open standard for it. You describe what the code does once: spans, attributes, errors. Then an exporter decides where it goes. {{otel}} In this lesson the exporter is your terminal. In production it would be Azure Monitor. The code above the exporter does not change. {{end}}
